observations.body: Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: A new thing is described as a way in the wilderness and rivers in the desert.
observations.label: A new way after the sea

observations.body: Earlier deliverance is recalled before a wilderness road and desert rivers are announced.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read Isaiah 43:17–22 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: The new act is linked to the old one without being reduced to a repetition.
payload.title: A way and rivers
